Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the point where he wants to become a doctor, add his motivation with a short thought or quotation: “我要找到能治病的植物。”
2. When he reaches the plant, add a visual detail to make the setting easier to imagine: “那儿开着黄色的花，像星星一样。”
3. After the long journey, show his physical feeling before he sees the plant: “他走了三个月，又累又渴。”

ideas.reason: This gives Shen Nong a clear, fitting motivation that matches his wish to help sick people.
This adds a simple visual detail without conflicting with the scene or the tale.
This gives a concrete physical feeling that naturally follows his three-month journey.
